recent_weekly_summaries.thesis: MU Q3 FY2026 record earnings (revenue $41.5B +346% YoY, EPS +24% beat, Q4 guided $50B) confirm AI memory supercycle. Portfolio consolidates to 3 positions: AMAT (AI equipment supercycle, analyst targets $720-$790), LLY (Medicare GLP-1 Bridge July 1 launch, +24% gain), MU (post-ATH dip entry). Close VECO/COHU/ACLS/SMTC (lock 12-20% gains). PCE June 30 primary macro risk. 4-day trading week (July 3 holiday).

Semiconductor sector profit-taking after record H1 creates rotation. MU likely stopped out at -5% from late-June entry (~$1,133→$975, -14% drawdown). AMD replaces MU as AI compute play — #1 momentum scorer (RS60=+66%, Data Center $5.8B +57% YoY, OpenAI+Meta 6GW GPU deployments, earnings Aug 4). AMAT holds through equipment-sector correction (stop $391 far from $603 current, supercycle intact). LLY holds on Medicare GLP-1 Bridge July 1 launch success.

close_reasons.MU: Stop likely triggered at ~$1,076 (-5% from ~$1,133 entry); price hit $975 by July 2 (-14% from entry range). AI memory thesis intact long-term — watchlist for re-entry above $1,050.

CPI July 14 — key inflation print (PCE running 4%+ above 2% target)
AMD: Helios GPU ramp begins Q3 2026 — OpenAI/Meta 6GW deployment windows
AMAT/MU: Semiconductor sector correction (profit-taking after record H1, not thesis change)
